strengths: Correctly establishes T-cell lineage from CD3E, CD3D, LCK, LAT, CD7, LTB.
Recognizes the naive/resting state via LEF1, CCR7, MAL, PIK3IP1, SELL, CD27.
Avoids CD4 commitment in the primary top1 label.
weaknesses: Top1 remains at the T-cell ancestor level rather than the supported naive T-cell refinement.
Top2 composite label includes CD4+ naive/central memory components without direct CD4 or memory markers in the DEG list.

strengths: Provides the clean supported refinement to naive T cell without adding unsupported CD4/CD8 or central-memory components.
Supported by the same core markers: LEF1, CCR7, MAL, PIK3IP1, SELL, CD27 plus T-lineage genes CD3E/CD3D/LCK/LAT.
Conservative and consistent with the absence of activation, cytotoxic, NK, B-cell, and myeloid markers.
weaknesses: Top1 label is the broader T cell, leaving the more informative naive T-cell call in the second rank.
Does not resolve CD4 vs CD8, but this is appropriately conservative given the marker evidence.

strengths: Correctly recognizes the naive T-cell state and maps to CL:0000898.
Correctly notes absence of cytotoxic and NK markers such as GZMB, PRF1, FCGR3A, FGFBP2.
Identifies LEF1/CCR7/SELL/CD27 as consistent with a naive/resting T-cell program.
weaknesses: Adds CD4+ and central-memory-like components that are not directly supported by cluster-level markers; no CD4 or CD8 lineage markers are present.
CCR7/SELL/CD27 are shared with central memory T cells, so the central-memory component is not positively supported.
Overstates lineage confidence relative to the observed DEG evidence.

supporting: CD3E, CD3D, LCK, LAT, CD7, LTB establish T-cell lineage.
LEF1, CCR7, MAL, PIK3IP1, SELL, CD27 directly support the naive/resting T-cell refinement.
Naive T-cell identity is consistent with the observed absence of effector/cytotoxic markers and with PMID 36658547.
conflicting: No CD4 or CD8 lineage-defining markers are present among the DEGs, so CD4+ specificity in the enrichment label is unsupported.
CCR7/SELL/CD27 are shared with central memory T cells, so the central-memory-like component is not positively supported at cluster level.
enrichment_or_literature: Dossier enrichment terms: T cell differentiation, T cell receptor signaling pathway, alpha-beta T cell receptor complex, TCR signaling, KEGG hsa04658/hsa04659.
Literature evidence retrieved in dossier includes PMID 36658547 supporting T-cell identity.
